   - Date ranges: 2021-01-01 to 2021-12-31 versus 2016-01-01 to 2016-12-31.
   - Location: Buffer 10 km around Villarrica, Chile (~-39.28, -72.23).

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
villarrica = ee.Geometry.Point([-72.23, -39.28]).buffer(10000)
def annual_rain(year):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')\
            .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')\
            .select('precipitation')
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{year} Images: 0")
        return None, 0
    total = col.sum()
    count = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=villarrica, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    val = total.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=villarrica, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    print(f"{year} Images: {n}, Pixels: {int(count)}, Mean: {val:.1f} mm")
    return val, int(count)

# 2. Compute rainfall totals
r21, c21 = annual_rain(2021)
r16, c16 = annual_rain(2016)

elif c21 == 0 or c16 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
